name: USA Medical
description: USA Medical sells CBG oil and hemp-derived wellness products direct to consumers online, marketed around holistic, plant-based daily wellness.

evidence.summary: USA Medical's own affiliate page offers creators 30% of every sale made through their unique link or coupon, a 30-day cookie, monthly payouts via PayPal, a free bottle of CBG Oil and custom banners/coupons. The program is aimed at influencers, bloggers and YouTubers and requires a minimum of 1,000 followers.

The program FAQ's 'How Much Commission Can I Earn?' answer states verbatim: 'The more you share your special link and the more people buy through it, the more money you can make. There's no limit!' - an explicit no-limit statement about earnings on the brand's own page, so the cap is verified uncapped.

One section of the same page (linking from Facebook/Instagram) mentions '40%' once, against 30% stated repeatedly throughout the rest of the page; the dominant published figure of 30% is recorded and the stray mention is documented here.

opportunity.title: USA Medical affiliate program - 30% commission, no earnings limit stated in the program FAQ on the brand's own page

reasons.niche_fit: CBG/hemp oil sits in the wellness niche with routine-based content angles, though it is a single-product line.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The program page is written directly for influencers, bloggers and YouTubers, with free product, custom coupons and banners and a link-in-bio requirement.
reasons.compensation: A 30% commission plus an explicit 'There's no limit!' answer to the earnings question on the brand's own FAQ - the cap is verified uncapped.
reasons.contact_access: No email is published on the program page; contact is through the join form only.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application with near-instant approval, but a 1,000-follower minimum narrows eligibility.
reasons.credibility: A small, little-known hemp brand with basic program copy; far less established than the large CBD names.

name: Aspen Green
description: Aspen Green makes USDA certified organic, full-spectrum hemp and CBD products - oils, gummies, capsules and topicals - formulated with input from a former Mayo Clinic physician and sold direct to consumers.

evidence.summary: Aspen Green's official Awin merchant profile states '30% commissions to start with the potential to substantially increase payouts based on volume', a 30-day tracking gap, custom discounts, bonuses and dedicated account management, and publishes the contact jbrenner@aspengreen.com.

Aspen Green's own affiliate page confirms the program is free to join, accepts US-based affiliates only, evaluates each applicant individually with a response within 5 business days if accepted, and that affiliate payments are processed by Awin twice a month.

Lasso lists Aspen Green at 15% per sale with a 60-day cookie, which conflicts with the official Awin profile's 30% starting rate and 30-day tracking; the Awin profile figure governs and the dissent is documented here.

opportunity.title: Aspen Green affiliate program via Awin - 30% starting commission on the official Awin merchant profile

reasons.niche_fit: Premium organic CBD fits wellness and sleep-content creators well.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The Awin profile and brand page address health, wellness and CBD affiliates with custom discounts and bonuses, though the program is application-screened.
reasons.compensation: A 30% starting commission on the official Awin profile, with published potential to rise with volume; no cap statement is published, so the cap stays unknown.
reasons.contact_access: A named affiliate contact email (jbrenner@aspengreen.com) is published on the Awin profile.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Individually evaluated applications and US-only acceptance limit open availability.
reasons.credibility: USDA certified organic positioning and a physician-formulation claim support credibility; a mid-size CBD brand.

name: Nature's Lab
description: Nature's Lab is a US supplement brand selling vitamins, minerals and specialty formulas, including its One Daily multivitamin line, direct to consumers and through major retailers.

evidence.summary: Nature's Lab's own published Affiliate/Referral Program Terms & Conditions state that affiliates earn a commission of twenty percent (20%) on eligible purchases made through their affiliate link or code, that commissions are disbursed through the Tremendous software program, and that US residents register through the brand's website or an approved platform.
Lasso lists Nature's Lab at 9% per sale, which conflicts with the 20% stated in the brand's own current program terms; the brand's own terms govern and the dissent is documented here.

opportunity.title: Nature's Lab affiliate program - 20% commission stated in the brand's own published program terms

reasons.niche_fit: Mainstream vitamins and supplements fit general wellness content.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A formal affiliate/referral program exists in the brand's own terms, but the brand publishes little creator-specific material.
reasons.compensation: 20% on eligible purchases per the brand's own terms - a solid published rate; no cap statement is published, so the cap stays unknown.
reasons.contact_access: No affiliate email is published; registration runs through the brand's website or an approved platform.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open to US residents who register, per the program terms.
reasons.credibility: An established US supplement brand with retail distribution.

name: CBDistillery
description: CBDistillery, founded in 2016, sells full-spectrum, broad-spectrum and isolate CBD oils, gummies, softgels, topicals and pet products direct to consumers at value prices, with third-party lab testing and U.S. Hemp Authority certification.

evidence.summary: CBDistillery's own affiliate page states the program is free to apply for and runs on Katalys, reports over $2,000,000 in commissions paid, a $90 average order value and 16% average conversion rate, and says the brand is actively looking for partners on emerging platforms like TikTok, Twitch and Reddit. No commission rate is published on the page.

Published rates conflict across sources - Lasso lists 10% per sale via Impact with a 90-day cookie, while other program guides report 20% flat or tiered 20-35% - so commission_rate is recorded null with the conflict documented here.

opportunity.title: CBDistillery affiliate program via Katalys - brand page reports $2M+ commissions paid and $90 AOV; rate not published by the brand

reasons.niche_fit: One of the largest US CBD catalogs (100+ SKUs) fits CBD education and routine content squarely.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand's own page explicitly recruits TikTok, Twitch and Reddit partners and offers links, promo codes and campaign assets.
reasons.compensation: The brand publishes no rate and third-party figures conflict (10% vs 20% vs tiered 20-35%), so the rate is honestly null; the $90 AOV is a positive signal.
reasons.contact_access: Application and partnership contact run through the brand's affiliate page; no direct email is published there.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Free, open application on Katalys with approval.
reasons.credibility: Founded 2016, U.S. Hemp Authority certified, over 2 million products sold - among the most established US CBD brands.

name: Green Roads
description: Green Roads is a pharmacist-formulated CBD brand selling oils, gummies, capsules, topicals and CBD coffee and tea through its own store and more than 10,000 US retail locations.

evidence.summary: Green Roads' own affiliate page describes its Partner Program (apply, get approved, promote, earn commission), a default 30-day cookie and a typically $100+ average order value, and describes compensation only as a 'competitive, customizable compensation structure' - no rate is published on the page.

Third-party readings conflict: TribeTokes reports Green Roads' Awin program terms as 30% on new customers and 17% on returning ones, AffRoom lists up to 30% via ShareASale, and Shopper lists 5-10%. With the brand publishing no rate, commission_rate is recorded null and the network is recorded as Awin per the terms reading, both flagged here.

opportunity.title: Green Roads Partner Program - pharmacist-formulated CBD; brand publishes no rate, third-party terms readings conflict

reasons.niche_fit: Pharmacist-formulated CBD with wide retail presence fits wellness content and converts on brand recognition.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand runs a named Partner Program for promoters on web and social, with an application and approval flow.
reasons.compensation: No rate is published by the brand and third-party figures conflict (30%/17% split vs up to 30% vs 5-10%), so the rate is honestly null.
reasons.contact_access: Contact runs through the affiliate page; the page's email is not published in readable form.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Application with approval; program bars brand bidding and new coupon sites per reported terms.
reasons.credibility: Long-running CBD brand with 10,000+ retail locations and national media coverage.
